messages.content: what is the latest version of TypeScript? use web_search

Search results for "latest TypeScript version 2025":

1. Announcing TypeScript 5.9 - TypeScript - devblogs.microsoft.com
   https://devblogs.microsoft.com/typescript/announcing-typescript-5-9/
   This new version is meant to align with TypeScript 7.0, introducing deprecations around certain settings and possibly updating type-checking behavior in small ways.

2. typescript - npm
   https://www.npmjs.com/package//typescript?activeTab=versions
   TypeScript is a language for application scale JavaScript development. Latest version: 5.9.3, last published: a month ago. Start using typescript in your project by running `npm i typescript`. There are 61338 other projects in the npm registry using typescript.

3. Releases · microsoft/TypeScript - GitHub
   https://github.com/Microsoft/TypeScript/releases
   TypeScript is a superset of JavaScript that compiles to clean JavaScript output. - Releases · microsoft/TypeScript

4. What's New in TypeScript 5.9? A Developer's Guide to the Latest ...
   https://medium.com/@purushotam_k/whats-new-in-typescript-5-9-a-developer-s-guide-to-the-latest-features-17b0e94cae91
   The latest version, TypeScript 5.9 (released August 2025), introduces exciting new features, performance improvements, and tooling updates that make development even more seamless.

5. Microsoft TypeScript 5.9 Released: Deferred Imports and ... - WinBuzzer
   https://winbuzzer.com/2025/08/04/microsoft-typescript-5-9-released-deferred-imports-and-paving-the-way-for-native-go-compiler-xcxwbn/
   Microsoft has officially launched TypeScript 5.9, a significant update to its popular typed superset of JavaScript. Released on August 1, 2025, the new version delivers major developer experience ...

The latest version of TypeScript is **5.9.3** (as shown on npm). The major release was **TypeScript 5.9**, announced in August 2025, which introduced features like deferred imports and alignment with TypeScript 7.0 deprecations.
